name: 86 Chaos 16.0.25 Workspace Cleanup and Mobile Tab Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.25 Workspace Cleanup and Mobile Tab Fix
notes: Prevents deleted Full Audit QA restaurants from lingering in the workspace selector after cleanup.
Filters missing, deleted, archived, and strict Full Audit QA workspace entries out of selectable workspaces without changing permission logic or Firebase configuration.
Fixes mobile tab/action buttons so labels stay horizontal and usable instead of stacking one letter per line.
Preserves the compact professional UI refinement, app workflows, Firebase wiring, rules, environment values, and Vercel function configuration.
releaseNotes: Workspace selector now filters stale QA audit workspace memberships that can remain in local cached account data after the QA cleanup endpoint removes restaurants.
The workspace memberships API no longer returns phantom workspaces for restaurant documents that no longer exist or are marked deleted/archived/inactive.
Mobile financial and other scrollable tab bars keep horizontal button labels inside an internal scroller instead of compressing labels into vertical columns.
No Firebase credentials, rules, project IDs, environment values, data models, permissions, or restaurant workflows were changed.
